using JSON3, Base64
module MN end
Base.include_string(MN, String(base64decode("")))
module MG end
Base.include_string(MG, String(base64decode("")))
module MNA end
Base.include_string(MNA, String(base64decode("")))
module MGA end
Base.include_string(MGA, String(base64decode("")))

using CUDA
const MODS = Dict("N" => MN, "G" => MG, "NA" => MNA, "GA" => MGA)
res = Dict{String,Any}("device" => string(CUDA.name(CUDA.device())), "rows" => Any[])
function mk(M, n)
    J = M.JACC
    b = J.array([1.0 + 0.5 * sin(1.7 * i + 0.3 * i * i) + 0.3 * cos(2.9 * i) for i in 1:n])
    z() = J.zeros(Float64, n); o() = J.zeros(Float64, 1)
    return (b = b, bb = z(), x = z(), xb = J.array([cos(0.37 * i) for i in 1:n]), r = z(), rb = z(), p = z(), pb = z(), Ap = z(), Apb = z(), rs = o(), rsb = o(), s = o(), sb = o(), t = o(), tb = o())
end
function run_adj(M, n, maxit)
    a = mk(M, n); st = M.initstacks_br_cg1d2_b_jacc(maxit, n); CUDA.synchronize()
    t0 = time_ns()
    CUDA.@sync M.br_cg1d2_b_jacc(a.b, a.bb, a.x, a.xb, a.r, a.rb, a.p, a.pb, a.Ap, a.Apb, a.rs, a.rsb, a.s, a.sb, a.t, a.tb, n, maxit, 1.0e-300, 0.0, st...)
    return (time_ns() - t0) / 1e6, (Array(a.xb), Array(a.bb))
end
function run_pri(M, n, maxit)
    a = mk(M, n); CUDA.synchronize(); t0 = time_ns()
    CUDA.@sync M.br_cg1d2_jacc(a.b, a.x, a.r, a.p, a.Ap, a.rs, a.s, a.t, n, maxit, 1.0e-300)
    return (time_ns() - t0) / 1e6
end
for (n, maxit) in ((16, 8), (256, 32), (4096, 50), (65536, 50), (1048576, 50))
    row = Dict{String,Any}("n" => n, "maxit" => maxit)
    ref = nothing
    for v in ("N", "G", "NA", "GA")
        M = MODS[v]
        try
            for w in 1:2; run_adj(M, n, maxit); run_pri(M, n, maxit); end
            ba = Inf; bp = Inf; out = nothing
            for rep in 1:6
                (t, o) = run_adj(M, n, maxit); ba = min(ba, t); out = o; bp = min(bp, run_pri(M, n, maxit))
            end
            row[v * "_adj_us"] = ba * 1e3 / maxit; row[v * "_pri_us"] = bp * 1e3 / maxit
            ref === nothing && (ref = out)
            row[v * "_rel_vs_N"] = maximum(abs.(out[1] .- ref[1]); init = 0.0) / max(1.0, maximum(abs.(ref[1]))) + maximum(abs.(out[2] .- ref[2]); init = 0.0) / max(1.0, maximum(abs.(ref[2])))
        catch e
            row[v * "_error"] = first(sprint(showerror, e), 400)
        end
    end
    push!(res["rows"], row)
end
println(JSON3.write(res))
